merged_sources.title: 同为x86-64的二进制为何仍可能不能在旧CPU运行？

conversion.original_title: 新制品在新服务器正常、旧x86-64服务器立即SIGILL，故障指令需要AVX。如何恢复？

body:
## 操作任务
实现install_compatible(releases,cpu_features,output)。这是已批准教学制品清单，每项含唯一非空id、普通非符号链接path、sha256（小写64位）、requires特性列表及唯一严格整数priority；cpu_features及requires仅允许sse2/avx且不重复。先完整校验每个制品字节与SHA，再从requires为CPU特性子集的候选选priority最高者，复制到同目录私有候选后原子替换output并设0755；返回id/sha256。输出不得是符号链接或与任一源同路径，无可用、哈希不符或非法清单ValueError，失败保留原输出、全部输入及无关文件，清理.release-*。夹具实际GCC生成两套小型教学ELF，并用用户态CPU模型执行同一制品；不能忽略SIGILL、伪造成功或把最高版本等同CPU兼容。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际QEMU7.2.22 Linux用户态CPU指令执行：Nehalem CPUID无AVX，SandyBridge CPUID有AVX，同一AVX制品在前者收到SIGILL、后者完成；兼容基线制品在两者都完成相同计算。仅私有教学ELF，非物理旧服务器/固件/内核模块/生产制品验收；不启动VM/KVM、不注册binfmt或更改宿主CPU配置，不编译镜像。制品清单的批准与特性声明由夹具提供，真实发布须开发提供并核验来源。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,resource,secrets,stat,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
modern='#include <immintrin.h>\n#include <stdio.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>\nint main(int argc,char**argv){float x=strtof(argv[1],0);__m256 a=_mm256_set1_ps(x);__m256 b=_mm256_add_ps(a,_mm256_set1_ps(1));float out[8];_mm256_storeu_ps(out,b);printf("%.0f\\n",out[0]);return 0;}\n'
portable='#include <stdio.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>\nint main(int argc,char**argv){long x=strtol(argv[1],0,10);printf("%ld\\n",x+1);return 0;}\n'
features='#include <cpuid.h>\n#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){unsigned a,b,c,d;__get_cpuid(1,&a,&b,&c,&d);printf("%d %d\\n",!!(d&(1u<<26)),!!(c&(1u<<28)));return 0;}\n'
for name,source,flags in [('modern',modern,['-mavx']),('portable',portable,['-march=x86-64','-mno-avx']),('features',features,['-march=x86-64','-mno-avx'])]:
 pathlib.Path(name+'.c').write_text(source)
 p=subprocess.run(['gcc','-O1',*flags,name+'.c','-o',name],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
OLD='Nehalem';NEW='SandyBridge,-x2apic,-tsc-deadline'
def execute(cpu,name,value=None):
 args=['qemu-x86_64','-cpu',cpu,str(pathlib.Path(name).resolve())]
 if value is not None:args.append(str(value))
 return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=4)
old=execute(OLD,'features');new=execute(NEW,'features')
assert old.returncode==new.returncode==0 and old.stdout=='1 0\n' and new.stdout=='1 1\n',(old.stdout,new.stdout)
number=secrets.randbelow(100000)+50;artifact_sha=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('modern').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
bad=execute(OLD,'modern',number);good=execute(NEW,'modern',number)
assert bad.returncode in (-4,132) and 'Illegal instruction' in bad.stderr and good.returncode==0 and good.stdout==str(number+1)+'\n'
assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('modern').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==artifact_sha
assert not list(pathlib.Path('.').glob('core*'))
releases=[{'id':'portable','path':'portable','sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('portable').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'requires':['sse2'],'priority':10},{'id':'modern','path':'modern','sha256':artifact_sha,'requires':['sse2','avx'],'priority':20}]
before=copy.deepcopy(releases);input_bytes={name:pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes() for name in ('portable','modern')}
pathlib.Path('current').write_bytes(b'PREVIOUS APPROVED OUTPUT');pathlib.Path('protected').write_bytes(b'KEEP')
print('NATIVE_SAME_AVX_ELF_SIGILL_ON_NEHALEM_CPUID_NO_AVX_PASSES_SANDYBRIDGE_CPUID_AVX',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:select_verified_cpu_compatible_release_and_publish_owned_elf',flush=True)
try:result=task.install_compatible(releases,['sse2'],'current')
except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('CPU-compatible artifact recovery failed') from error
for cpu in (OLD,NEW):
 p=execute(cpu,'current',number);assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout==str(number+1)+'\n',('recovered binary still fails on target CPU',cpu,p.returncode,p.stderr)
assert result=={'id':'portable','sha256':releases[0]['sha256']} and hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('current').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==releases[0]['sha256']
assert stat.S_IMODE(pathlib.Path('current').stat().st_mode)==0o755
second=task.install_compatible(releases,['sse2','avx'],'new-target');assert second=={'id':'modern','sha256':artifact_sha}
p=execute(NEW,'new-target',number);assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout==str(number+1)+'\n'
stable=pathlib.Path('current').read_bytes()
for candidate,features in [([{**releases[0],'sha256':'0'*64}],['sse2']),(releases,[]),(releases,['unknown']),(releases+[dict(releases[0])],['sse2']),([{'id':'incomplete'}],['sse2']),([{**releases[0],'requires':[[]]}],['sse2'])]:
 try:task.install_compatible(candidate,features,'current')
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('tampered/unapproved artifact or unsupported CPU compatibility accepted')
 assert pathlib.Path('current').read_bytes()==stable
try:task.install_compatible(releases,['sse2'],'portable')
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('source artifact overwrite accepted')
assert releases==before and all(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in input_bytes.items())
assert pathlib.Path('protected').read_bytes()==b'KEEP' and not list(pathlib.Path('.').glob('.release-*'))
print('NATIVE_APPROVED_BASELINE_ELF_RECOVERS_BOTH_CPU_MODELS_AVX_ELF_ONLY_ON_COMPATIBLE_CPU_TAMPER_OUTPUT_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
